title: avenula albinervis
intro: Avenula albinervis, commonly known as oat grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is known to have several health benefits, including its potential to help lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The therapeutic actions of Avenula albinervis include its ability to act as a digestive aid, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which may contribute to its potential in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Avenula albinervis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and fatty acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
